verdict.rationale: Justworks runs payroll and collects employees' filing status, withholding and exemption information at enrollment, so they don't file a W-4 themselves. That covers the withholding element in a general way, but the evidence never mentions multiple states, state tax registrations, or per-state withholding rules. Missing for 10: documented multi-state payroll support, state tax account registration handling, per-state withholding and tax calculation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
